notes.title: Spoiler Alert! & QnA
notes.content:
Hello everyone! You haven't heard from me in a while due to me taking the summer off, but I've secretly started working on Communist Clicker 2! I'll link a spoiler of the main menu in this post, and in the comments you can feel free to ask any questions you want about the upcoming Communist Clicker 2. We will also be taking into consideration any suggestions for the game that you all can leave in the comments as well. Enjoy the rest of the weekend!

- TheGamer982

notes.title: Ear Protection
notes.content:
Added:
- Music toggle on/off button in the gameplay menu.
- Experimental support for MacOS users.
Changed:
- Stonks now have a higher chance to increase in price.
- Nukes have a negative impact on the stonks market.
- The "Crash Stonks Market" item in the black market now has a greater impact on the stonks market.
- Nukes improve stats like workers, effort, and clicks.
